method.name: markWaiting
method.purpose: Sets or clears the waiting_on column of a processing message (schema version 2; QueuedMessage gains waitingOn?: 'approval' | 'selection'), so every window's list() shows that the running message waits on a card; false when the row is not processing

rationale: The HLD's s2 boundary says other chats' outboxes say which chat a waiting card holds the queue for. Only the window running the message knows of the card, and the lease row has no such field (chat-queue-store.ts lease table); putting the flag on the processing message row means every window gets it in the rows it already reads through list() / onChange, and it ends with the message. Additive: a nullable column added by a version-1 to version-2 upgrade on open.
